# Rentespøgelset slår til igen - globale aktier sendes lavere

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-09-24  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Millionærklubben episode (Euroinvestor/Saxo Bank) looks at a market that rising yields pushed lower. Strong PMI data lifted the US 10-year yield to its highest since 2007. Guest Thijs Knudsen (Kirk Kapital) is firmly risk-on: he argues that rising real rates are healthy, that all four business cycles point upward on AI/capex/infrastructure, and that no recession is likely, so his team is overweight equities. Guest Jacob Garf covers single stocks and is negative on Novo Nordisk and General Mills, lukewarm on DSV, and flags SEB's upgrade of GN Store Nord and a flat H&M report.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Jacob Garf (guest) says Novo is still a fairly bad case on the numbers: down 10% after its CMD, losing to Eli Lilly, and too many employees.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. The capital markets day failed to turn sentiment despite a rebrand, new management and five promised blockbusters by 2035. Eli Lilly has 28% fewer staff yet higher revenue and earnings. The core business is profitable, but the stock keeps falling, so he calls buying it 'home bias' rather than a sound case. The guest does not own the stock.

#### Sell Triggers

- if pipeline blockbusters deliver ahead of schedule
- if Novo closes the efficiency/margin gap to Eli Lilly
- if the share price trend reverses on positive news

> *"Men hvis vi kigger på tallene, så er det bare stadig desværre en ret dårlig case i øjeblikket."*

---

### ⛔ GIS — General Mills | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Jacob Garf is sceptical of the turnaround: the stock is down from 90 to 35, and he expects K-shaped economy trade-down to keep hurting branded middle-market goods.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. The quarter was slightly better than expected, but the share price has not confirmed the turnaround. The core customer is the middle class, which is being squeezed as consumers either trade down to private label at Walmart/Costco or trade up. He expects the company to keep having a relatively hard time.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the turnaround shows sustained volume/margin recovery
- if the middle-class consumer recovers

> *"Og derfor tror jeg, at General Mills kommer til at fortsætte at have det relativt svært."*

---

### 🟠 GN — GN Store Nord | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

This is SEB analysts' view, cited by the guest: after the Amplifon hearing-division sale they see 150 vs 105. The market has only partly followed.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst view, not the hosts'. SEB's new analysis sent the stock up 8-10%, but it has since drifted lower and is down about 1% today. Jacob notes that analysts can move stocks in the short term, but the market does not simply accept the 150 target. The upside case rests on value unlocked by the divestment.

#### Sell Triggers

- if other analysts don't follow SEB's upgrade
- if the post-divestment business underdelivers

> *"de har regnet og regnet og fundet ud af, at nu skal den pludselig ligge i 150, og den ligger i 105 nu."*

---

### 🟠 DSV — DSV | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Fundamentally healthy with a strong M&A and integration track record, but about 25% below its peak after Schenker. The next catalyst is unclear, and Kuehne+Nagel's Amazon deal was a setback.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion (Jacob Garf). The DB Schenker deal made DSV the world's largest, and synergies are reportedly being harvested quickly. However, the market dislikes the story, a competitor won a big Amazon contract, and there is no clear next big move. Founder Leif Tullberg argues it is undervalued. The view is mixed, so this is a watch rather than a buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Schenker synergies disappoint
- if further large contracts go to competitors

> *"Så hvis du kigger på fundamentalerne, er det et ret sundt selskab"*

---
